objective: Implement the GDN core over this fixed-structure packed-varlen domain. All valid B/T/splits are supported; exact validation case IDs, RNG seeds or provenance may not drive kernel specializations.
invariants: cu_seqlens[0] == 0; cu_seqlens[-1] == T; cu_seqlens strictly increasing
input tensors contiguous; only output and output_state buffers may be mutated

coverage_regimes.name: packed_varlen
coverage_regimes.requirement: Handle nonuniform sequence splits, tails and independent per-sequence states.

coverage_regimes.name: initial_state
coverage_regimes.requirement: Handle zero and carried FP32 state.

workload_profile.note: Fixed Qwen3.8-Max TP4 per-GPU structure. Dynamic B/T envelope is a benchmark design constraint, not a claim that every combination was captured in production. B<=16 is a conservative support ceiling for the C32/TP4/DP2 target; external observed coverage reaches B15. T<=16384 matches the explicit task cap and deployed max_num_batched_tokens.

implementation_rules: Specialization may use public tensor metadata and mathematical invariants; do not dispatch on exact validation cases, seeds, source IDs, expected output values or a table of benchmark splits.
No Q normalization or gate projections in this operator; K normalization is completed in input generation.
Any candidate algorithm or chunk size is allowed; no M64 or CP implementation requirement.
Write all elements of the preallocated output/output_state buffers and return them as (output, output_state). Other inputs are read-only.
